summary: The two probes that read from the console, each typed at from the debug shell in a boot of its own; the scenario is machine/console_scenario.c and the probes tests/stdintest.c and tests/ttyprobe.c

cases.behavior: stdintest reads three lines typed at the console and prints what each read gave: alpha, then bravo line, then five bytes of charlie-delta, which a read of at most five bytes must cut

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes its evidence, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot the test image to the debug shell
run stdintest, type each line once the probe asks for it, wait for the record that hands the shell back and end the machine with QMP's quit

assertions.checks: the first read gives the 5 bytes alpha
the second read gives the 10 bytes bravo line
a read of at most 5 bytes of charlie-delta gives the 5 bytes charl
stdintest says that all its reads passed
the kernel's record that hands the shell back says that stdintest exited with status 0

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the case types lines at the machine's console, which a native run cannot

cases.behavior: ttyprobe reads a cooked line typed with two erases in it as the line they leave, a byte typed after it switches the console to raw with no newline, the screen's answers to its two queries with nothing typed, and Alt with x pressed on the machine's keyboard as ESC and x

inputs.cooked: ab, two DEL, cd and a newline

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes its evidence, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot the test image to the debug shell

run ttyprobe, type the cooked line and the raw byte and press Alt with x through QMP, each once the probe says it reads, wait for the record that hands the shell back and end the machine with QMP's quit

assertions.checks: the cooked read of ab, two erases and cd gives cd and the newline
the raw read gives X with no newline
the probe reads Alt with x as ESC and x, and ends saying TTYPROBE OK
the probe names no failed check
the kernel's record that hands the shell back says that ttyprobe exited with status 0

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the case types at the machine's console and presses a key on its keyboard, which a native run cannot
